changeSet.sql: IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.Survey', 'Uid') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.Survey ADD Uid uniqueidentifier NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_Survey_Uid] DEFAULT newid() WITH VALUES END IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.SurveyType', 'Uid') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.SurveyType ADD Uid uniqueidentifier NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_SurveyType_Uid] DEFAULT newid() WITH VALUES END IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.Question', 'Uid') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.Question ADD Uid uniqueidentifier NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_Question_Uid] DEFAULT newid() WITH VALUES END IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.QuestionType', 'Uid') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.QuestionType ADD Uid uniqueidentifier NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_QuestionType_Uid] DEFAULT newid() WITH VALUES END
